deadline.intake: 2026/27, non-EU (visa) pre-selection deadline (passed); Universitaly registration by 30 June 2026

tuition.note: EUR 300-1,500/yr depending on country of residence; no single amount

requirement.text: High school diploma after at least 12 years of study; mandatory pre-selection, Universitaly registration and study visa; B2 English or Italian depending on programme; some programmes need an admission test.
